member.name: T:RegexMatcher.Matcher
member.summary: Library to store regular expressions with a supplied object, and return that object when evaluating an input and a matching regular expression is found. Entries are evaluated in the order in which they were added. All methods are thread-safe.

member.name: F:RegexMatcher.Matcher.MatchPreference
member.summary: Specify how a match is selected when multiple regular expressions match the input. Default is MatchPreferenceType.First.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.Add(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex,System.Object)
member.summary: Add a regular expression and return value to the end of the evaluation list. Regular expressions are identified by instance; two distinct Regex instances with the same pattern are separate entries.
member.param: Regular expression. Must not be null.
Value to return when a match is found. May be null.
member.exception: Thrown when the same Regex instance has already been added.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.Remove(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex)
member.summary: Remove a regular expression from the evaluation list. No action is taken if the Regex instance is not present.
member.param: Regular expression. Must not be null.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.Get
member.summary: Retrieve a snapshot copy of the evaluation dictionary. Changes made to the returned dictionary do not affect the matcher, and the snapshot is safe to enumerate while other threads modify the matcher.
member.returns: Dictionary containing each regular expression and the value returned upon match. Never null.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.Exists(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex)
member.summary: Check if a regular expression instance exists in the evaluation list.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.AllMatches(System.String)
member.summary: Retrieve the values for every regular expression that matches the input, in the order in which they were added. MatchPreference does not affect this method.
member.param: The string to evaluate. Must not be null or empty.
member.returns: List of values. Empty if no regular expression matches. Never null.
member.exception: Thrown when val is null or empty.
Thrown when a regular expression with a timeout exceeds it.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.ValueExists(System.Object)
member.summary: Check if a value exists in the evaluation list. Values are compared using Object.Equals, so equal strings and boxed value types are found.
member.param: Object to match. May be null, in which case true is returned if any entry has a null value.

member.name: M:RegexMatcher.Matcher.Match(System.String,System.Object@)
member.summary: Evaluate the supplied string against the evaluation list. When multiple regular expressions match, MatchPreference determines which value is returned.
member.param: The string to evaluate. Must not be null or empty.
The object value mapped to the selected regular expression, or null if no match was found.
member.returns: True if a match was found.
member.exception: Thrown when inVal is null or empty.
Thrown when a regular expression with a timeout exceeds it.

member.name: T:RegexMatcher.MatchPreferenceType
member.summary: Specify how evaluation for a match should behave when multiple regular expressions match the input.

member.name: F:RegexMatcher.MatchPreferenceType.First
member.summary: Return the value for the first matching regular expression, in the order in which entries were added.

member.name: F:RegexMatcher.MatchPreferenceType.LongestFirst
member.summary: Return the value for the matching regular expression whose pattern string is longest, which typically indicates the most specific pattern. Ties are resolved in favor of the entry added first.

member.name: F:RegexMatcher.MatchPreferenceType.ShortestFirst
member.summary: Return the value for the matching regular expression whose pattern string is shortest, which typically indicates the least specific pattern. Ties are resolved in favor of the entry added first.
